metadata.notes:
Pagination after leaf 934 is erratic in this volume. The foldout pages at leaves 1367 and 1368 have been photographed at as high a resolution as was possible given the size and condition of the material therein. No copyright or contents pages are present. Tight binding has meant some print falls into the gutter in this volume with occasional feint type due to light impressions and with some pages cut close to the text causing occasional cropping.
Pagination generally reflects the separate issues bound together in this volume with occasional irregularities.
